Late Fee Rules

Discount Types

Single Invoice Generation

Counter Collection

Online Payments (bKash)
Initiate parent online fee payment with gateway redirect, process callback verification, generate receipt on success, and retry failed transactions.
Bank Transfer Verification
Review pending transfer submissions with optional proof, then approve to issue receipt or reject with reason.
Invoice Delivery
